evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and alters RPC whitelist error handling in httprpc.cpp and protocol.h.
rationale: Fixes a JSON-RPC 2.0 specification violation and prevents bitcoin-cli -ipcconnect from failing with cryptic JSON parse errors on -rpcwhitelist denials. The author notes that returning empty HTTP 403 contradicts the JSON-RPC 2.0 specification and breaks IPC clients because 'IPC carries only the response body, so a refused call prints a JSON type error instead of a permission error.'
